receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI expects about $5 billion in losses on $3.7 billion in revenue this year

evidence_items.explanation: The industry's leading firm expected to lose about $5 billion in 2024, more than its revenue. This supports 'burning billions of dollars'. It is a projection reported from company documents, not audited results.

evidence_items.locator: section From $16 million to $1.9 billion in three years, final paragraphs

receipt.public_excerpt: it has raised a total $12.9 billion in asset-backed debt through the end of 2024.

evidence_items.explanation: A major AI cloud provider funded its build-out with $12.9 billion of debt through 2024, on $1.92 billion of revenue and an $863 million net loss reported in the same article. This supports the leverage and loss parts for the AI infrastructure layer.

receipt.public_excerpt: The company attributed the emissions spike to an increase in data center energy consumption and supply chain emissions driven by rapid advancements in and demand for artificial intelligence.

evidence_items.explanation: Google itself blamed AI demand for its emissions rising nearly 50% since 2019 and 13% in 2023. The same article notes Microsoft's emissions rose nearly 30% since 2020, mainly from building data centers. Supports the environmental part.

unresolved_gaps: No primary audited 2024 figures for private firms such as OpenAI; the $5 billion figure is a reported projection.
'No real path to profitability' is partly a forward-looking judgment; evidence shows deep 2024 losses, not that profit is impossible.
The primary CoreWeave S-1 could not be read directly (HTTP 403).
